Lo siento,
Para Español, oprima el 2.
Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics, part of Pretty Good AI. How may I help you today?
Hi, yeah, I’ve been having some knee pain for about a week, and I’m hoping to set up a new-patient appointment as soon as possible. I’m pretty flexible on the day, but mornings would be best.
I can help with that. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Sure, it’s Asher Pranay Palle, and my date of birth is February 16, 1995.
Just to confirm, I have your name as Ashford Pauley and your date of birth as February 16th, 1995. Is that correct? If so, please spell your first and last name for me.
Sure, it’s A-S-H-E-R for the first name, and the last name is P-A-L-L-E.
Yeah, exactly, that’s what it’s for—my knee pain.
Thanks, Asher. Just to make sure I booked the right appointment, is this visit mainly to address your knee pain as a new patient?
There are several morning openings with Dr. Judy Hauser this Thursday. The earliest is at 10.30 a.m. Would you like to book that time?
Hmm, that could work. Let me double-check my schedule real quick.
No problem. Take your time and let me know if you want to keep the Thursday 1030 a.m. slot with Dr. Dugy Howser.
All right, I think that time works for me. Let’s go ahead and book it.

You're all set for Thursday, September 17th at 10.30 a.m. with Dr. Doogie Houser at Pivot Point Orthopedics. Please bring your photo ID, insurance card, a list of your current medications, and any imaging discs if you have them. Would you like me to text you these appointment details?
Yes, that would be great. Please send me the details by text, thanks.
The appointment details have already been sent to your phone. If you need anything else, just let me know.
Got it, I appreciate it. That’s all I needed for now. Thanks for your help, have a good one.
Thanks, you too. Take care.
You're welcome. Your appointment is confirmed. Have a great day!
